semantics.density: sqrt(width*height*abs(transformed UV triangle area)/world triangle area)
semantics.areaEquivalent: sqrt(sum pixel area/sum world area); world-area-weighted RMS triangle density
semantics.weightedPercentiles: inverse cumulative world area; triangle densities sorted ascending
semantics.areas: sum absolute triangle areas, including layered surfaces and UV overlaps; not atlas union or occupied unique texels
semantics.degenerate: world area exactly zero excluded and explicitly listed; zero UV area retained as zero density. Areas use exact integer-domain cross products/determinants of signed-clamped raw normalized attributes followed by the normalization divisor and world linear cofactor. This avoids false nonzero areas from subtracting translated float positions. No epsilon filter is used.
semantics.distribution: descriptive bins only, no new pass/fail threshold
semantics.doubleSided: physical geometry area once; material doubleSided does not duplicate physical surface area
